description: Canonical fictional identity assignments for identity_benchmark.json (Phase 10S). Latent identity truth under ground_truth_schema='v3' is derived ONLY from these per-record fictional_identity_id values. Records marked canonical_identity_under_specified=true carry NO canonical identity: the fixture does not authorially establish whether they depict the same or different people, so v3 marks any pair involving them as canonical_identity_under_specified.
identity_rule: same_identity iff record_a.fictional_identity_id == record_b.fictional_identity_id; otherwise different_identity. No incident relation, expected_pair, extraction, or v2 correction table may influence v3 latent truth.
